goodCare.title: Good care starts close to home.
goodCare.text: Kings DryCleaners and Laundry serves you with one simple idea: make it easier to care for your clothes and your home, all in one place.
goodCare.highlight: Not just clothes. Everything you care for.
goodCare.text2: From everyday laundry and dry-cleaning to carpets, duvets, curtains, pressing and fumigation. We match the price to your items instead of offering a one-size-fits-all price.
